title: Is there a composite number passing the Baillie–PSW test?
formal: Does a composite integer pass both the strong base-2 probable-prime test and the strong Lucas probable-prime test with the standard Selfridge parameter-selection rule?
context:
The exact Lucas variant and parameter rule matter. Computational searches below a bound do not settle existence over all integers.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Tests the mathematical reliability of a widely used primality-testing combination.
